name: lumen5-video-creator
description: Create video projects in Lumen5 through the user's authorized Lumen5 account.

interface.longDescription: Plan a video, draft its script and scene outline, and use the connected Lumen5 account to create or manage a video project when the available Lumen5 tools support the requested action. The plugin should confirm key creative choices before making changes and report only results returned by Lumen5. Available actions depend on the tools and permissions exposed by the connected account.
defaultPrompt: Help me turn this idea into a Lumen5 video.
Create a short video from this article using my Lumen5 account.
Help me plan a video script and storyboard for Lumen5.

publication.release_notes: Draft 0.1.1: adds Lumen5 Technologies Ltd. publisher metadata and public website, support, privacy, and terms URLs. MCP tool discovery and end-to-end video creation remain unverified; complete authenticated scan, test cases, demo recording, and dashboard review before submission.
